headline: Teledyne reports record Q3 results with Varex deal pending
summary: Teledyne announced record results across all business segments alongside a pending $1.1 billion acquisition deal for Varex.
why: Teledyne Technologies is a diversified industrial conglomerate providing digital imaging, instrumentation, and aerospace electronics.

impacts.name: Teledyne Technologies
impacts.why: Record segment results demonstrate robust operational performance and strengthen corporate balance sheets.
